news.headline: Micron, Samsung, and SK Hynix Fail to Dismiss DRAM Price-Fixing Lawsuit
news.summary: A court has denied a motion by Micron Technology, Samsung, and SK Hynix to dismiss a lawsuit alleging price-fixing in the DRAM market.

news.headline: Chip Stocks Have 'Flushed Out Everybody:' Ryan Detrick Calls the 17% SOXX Rebound a Historic 'Buying Thrust'
news.summary: Ryan Detrick calls the 17% SOXX rebound a historic 'buying thrust,' signaling that the chip stock massacre has flushed out everybody.

news.headline: Intel Stock Down 3.8% Overnight on Robinhood as Lip-Bu Tan Faces Lawsuit Over PC Slowdown Disclosure
news.summary: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan faces a shareholder lawsuit over alleged concealment of PC market weakness ahead of the stock's 28.6% plunge.

news.headline: Coatue Management Increases Stake in Broadcom
news.summary: Coatue Management has increased its shareholding in Broadcom Inc. by 14.0%, bringing its total position to 6.7 million shares.

news.headline: ByteDance Collaborating with Broadcom on Advanced AI Processor Development
news.summary: ByteDance is reportedly working with Broadcom to develop an advanced artificial intelligence processor to support its computing needs.
